definition.linkCoverage: Systems with at least one resolved incoming or outgoing declared cross-link / declared Systems
definition.roundTripCoverage: Systems belonging to a strongly connected component of size > 1 / declared Systems
definition.roundTrip: Directed traversal can leave a System and return through one or more other Systems.

note: Measured from statically declared system IDs and explicit dependsOn/integratesWith/from-to relationships. Dynamic/runtime-created relationships are not counted; no reverse links were fabricated to improve the score.
